name: THE US GRANT
positioning: The US Grant, a Luxury Collection Hotel: a historic 1910 hotel in downtown San Diego near the Gaslamp Quarter and Little Italy, with a notable art collection and the Grant Grill
best_for: Travelers who want a historic hotel in downtown San Diego
Guests who enjoy art, history and hotel traditions
Visitors heading to Balboa Park, the San Diego Zoo or Petco Park

facts.text: The US Grant opened on October 15, 1910, after five years of construction in the heart of downtown San Diego.
The hotel is recognized as a Gaslamp Quarter historic hotel and preserves its architectural legacy.
The hotel is near Little Italy and the Gaslamp Quarter, at the heart of San Diego's dining, culture and nightlife.
Nearby attractions include Balboa Park, the San Diego Zoo, Petco Park and the Gaslamp Quarter.
Rooms showcase evocative art and finishes.
Pillowtop beds feature 350-thread-count sheets and designer duvets.
Marble bathrooms in select suites feature deep soaking tubs.
Suites include a Presidential Multi-Level Suite with a balcony and living room.
Grant Grill serves AAA/CAA Four Diamond cuisine in an Art Deco setting, with seasonal dishes from California produce and Pacific seafood.
Grant Grill has operated since 1951, with mahogany wood, fleur de lis banquettes and white linen-topped tables.
The fitness center is open 24 hours a day and is complimentary.

highlights.text: The hotel holds a collection of artworks, including sculptures, ironwork, murals and paintings, by European, American and Native American artists.
Every evening at dusk, the concierge team lights candles in the grand lobby, continuing the historic 'keeper of candles' tradition.
The concierge team leads a complimentary tour of the hotel's history and culture for overnight guests, starting Saturdays from the Concierge desk.
The 11-story historic building has a lobby with chandeliers, glossy tile floors and Corinthian-style columns.

considerations.text: Many room windows face other rooms, so guests may want to close the blinds for privacy.
WhataHotel notes that the premium downtown location is reflected in higher pricing.
